description: Display settings for the Gantt component – controls visibility of markers, task name location, row density, and theme.

members.name: ShowAdvancedContextButtons
members.description: Show additional items in the task context menu (Duplicate, Move, Copy link). Default: false.

members.name: ShowAvatarsOnChart
members.description: Show assignee avatars directly on task bars. Default: true.

members.name: ShowClosedTasks
members.description: Include tasks with Done/Closed status in the tree. Default: true.

members.name: ShowDaysOff
members.description: Shade non-working days (weekends/holidays) in the timeline. Default: true.

members.name: ShowProgressLabel
members.description: Show the completion percentage next to every task bar. Default: false.

members.name: ShowTodayMarker
members.description: Show the vertical today marker in the timeline. Default: true.

members.name: TaskNameLocation
members.description: Where the task name label is rendered relative to the bar. Default: InsideBar.

members.name: Theme
members.description: Color theme applied to the component. Default: Auto, which follows the ambient theme (the cascaded data-theme / the registered ThemeService); Light and Dark force data-theme on the Gantt root.

members.name: ViewDensity
members.description: Row height density. Default: Comfortable (40 px).

members.name: WbsInTitle
members.description: Show the WBS number (1.2.3) as a prefix of the task title in the tree. Default: false.
